note: City of Sibley campground in Sam Robinson Memorial Park beside Robinson Pond (a stocked fishing pond of about 2 acres), next to the golf course and the municipal pool. Restrooms, shower, playground and shelters. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed from the city page ($25 electric+water / $30 full hookup; previously unstored). Confirmed 18 sites, 50-amp max, water+sewer, showers, Apr 15-Oct 15 season, reservable; added WiFi, booking link, fcfs never and booking note. Not waterfront kept: Robinson Pond measures ~0.9 ha (~2 acres), a pond with no view value.
flags: FIT: no site length is posted on the city page and the engine (closed until March 1) could not be read; NAIP shows travel trailers and motorhomes on the gravel pads. No limit under 23 ft found; no caveat needed in my reading.
LAUNDRY: stored facilities.laundry true (from the old note) is not stated on the city page; left untouched, unverified.

WEBSITE: stored website is the booking engine; the city's own page https://sibleyiowa.net/pages/parks-recreation#camp (rates, rules, phone) is the operator's page and could replace or join it (apply.py does not write website). Stored phone 712-720-7005 matches the page's Park&Rec cell; the office line is 712-754-2330 (Google lists that one).
LONG-STAY (local, gates not applied): the city also sells monthly rates ($681 full hookup / $596 electric & water); every site is also sold nightly online.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Robinson Pond measured on NAIP at ~65 x 160 m (~0.9 ha, ~2 acres), under the 5-acre pond line, and the city calls it a pond; no pond-view.
PIN: 43.3990,-95.7362 sits on the campground loop west of the pond; fine.
